venue: BOK Center, Tulsa, Oklahoma (Jim Ross territory; old-school workrate-respect crowd)
context: Tulsa = JR country. Crowd respects ring psychology and promo work. Show partially logged — second half not captured (Hulu temporal mismatch). Cody-Gunther feud opens here.

segments.outcome: Video package recap. Fatu makes his way to the BOK Center — opens SmackDown. Tongan Deathclip framed as his own submission.
segments.notes: Fatu owns opening segment on BOTH brands consecutive weeks. Free-agent aitu — booking confirms cross-brand priority.

segments.outcome: Cody declares cleared for action; floats open challenge. Ricky Saints interrupts — main-roster debut. Saints: 'I came to change who the show is about.' Match made.
segments.notes: ~15% recognized Saints' entrance. Self-coronation in another man's kingdom triggered crowd's 'Cody' chant — immune response. False savior placement.

segments.outcome: Replay: Rhea vs Jacy (4/25). Charlotte + Alexa partnership holding. Rhea offers third — Charlotte rejects. 3-way announced: Rhea vs Alexa vs Charlotte (later show).
segments.notes: Charlotte's pride refusing the sovereign's help. Alexa caught in middle.

segments.outcome: Charlotte vs Jacy. Charlotte ~80% Euro-style chant. Fallon interference; Alexa assist not enough. Jacy wins via Rolling Encore. Post-match FI beatdown; Rhea answered the crowd's call, cleared house. Charlotte handshake-equal with Rhea to close.
segments.notes: FI gets first clean-ish win on SD — escalation from 4/25 DQs. Charlotte's pride cost her; humility opened the alliance. Macha's kingdom — handshake as equals.

segments.outcome: Light segment. Brie + Paige with Byron — 'we're here to do the thing'. Reign establishment.
Priest + Truth approached Fraxiom. Damian offered match. Truth: 'taxes... what?' Comedy on Thoth's surface-misread.
segments.notes: Recorder of truth misreads surface but stays in the right place.

segments.outcome: Miz + Wilson set trap. Danhausen: 'Falling into a trap for $400' — named the mechanism, walked away. Trap punished the trappers.
segments.notes: Heyoka identified the trap, refused, and the trap punished its setters. Sacred Clown's presence is enough.

segments.outcome: Priest & Truth def. Fraxiom. Damian one-man-showed the finish. Post-match: Tama + Solo appear. Solo waved goodbye — challenge laid.
segments.notes: Anubis rendered judgment alone. Solo can't challenge up after Fatu — challenges laterally.

segments.outcome: Solo + Talla in ring. 'You are a dead man walking' (Undertaker cadence). Usos music hits. Jey: 'That move [TDG] is last resort.' The Tongan Deathclip = sacred technique. Solo: 'You tell Roman that he ain't my tribal chief.'
segments.notes: Three declarations: TDG violated, Solo rejects Roman's authority, Solo wants Fatu dead. Family has a constitution; Fatu broke it.

segments.outcome: Sami trying to stay in Cody's orbit. Cody explicit: 'We are not the same.' Babyface tribe closed its door on the descending predecessor.
segments.notes: Cody draws the line. Sami sees the descent even if Sami won't name it. Danhausen aside: 'uncursed the Knicks.'

segments.outcome: Cody def. Ricky Saints via Cross Rhodes — clean but earned. Saints brought AEW ring style, forced Cody to dig deep. Crowd: third Euro-style chant of the night for Cody.
segments.notes: Saints made by losing — placement carried it. AEW register translated live.

segments.outcome: Post-Cody/Saints: Gunther immediately attacks. Sleeper hold on depleted Cody — refs can't stop him. Gunther repositioned the belt over the unconscious champion. Crowd: 'You suck.'
segments.notes: Predator timing — attacked the wounded king after a fight, not before. Cody-Gunther Backlash program opened. Show closes on Gunther over Cody.
